title: Same-Visit Courtesy on Collision and Structural Workmanship Warranties: Desk Card
content:
**Subject.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a same-visit courtesy is owed on a collision or structural workmanship warranty, that is, a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or a Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty, when an inspection date on which the coverage's inspections found an electrical or mechanical part not covered also brought a finding that a concern was covered, and that covered concern carries a network rework authorization; it is booked as a goodwill waiver against the larger of the parts diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before, and it never exceeds the plan's goodwill authority per charge.

**Prerequisite clauses.**

1. The same-visit courtesy is not worked out until the electrical diagnostic charge owed on every not-covered electrical-part finding of the visit stands on the coverage's account.
2. The same-visit courtesy is figured only after the mechanical diagnostic charge owed on every not-covered mechanical-part finding of the visit stands on the coverage's account.
3. The same-visit courtesy is booked only once the covered concern found at the visit carries its network rework authorization.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Plans | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty; Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
| Visit | An inspection date on which the coverage's inspections found an electrical or mechanical part not covered and also found a concern covered |
| Booked as | A goodwill waiver |
| Booked against | The larger of the parts diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before |
| Ceiling | Never more than the plan's goodwill authority per charge |

## The action: `book_same_visit_courtesy_9d7b5f0e`

**Capability.** Books the same-visit courtesy on a collision or structural workmanship warranty coverage: a goodwill waiver, dated today, against one parts diagnostic charge (electrical or mechanical) on the coverage's customer charges account, lowering what the customer owes on that charge by the amount given. The coverage's money history then shows a goodwill waiver naming the charge.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_same_visit_courtesy_9d7b5f0e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_coverage_id` | Reference number of the warranty coverage that carries the charge, as returned by the warranty coverage lookup | text reference number |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the parts diagnostic charge entry the courtesy is booked against, as shown in the coverage's money history or on the receipt of the charge's booking | text reference number |
| `amount_usd` | The courtesy amount | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "waived", `warranty_entry_id` (the new waiver entry's reference number), `source_entry_id` (the charge the courtesy is booked against), `waiver_reason` (always "goodwill"), `amount_usd` (2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD). The receipt's reference number confirms the courtesy is booked.
